# coolify_vulnerabilities (Data Source)

Lists applications, services, and databases on the token's team with their stored image-scan status. Requires Coolify >= v4.7.0. Coolify returns the worst status first. `status` limits the API request. `filter` narrows that response locally. Filter names: uuid, name, type, project_uuid, environment_uuid, server_uuid, and status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_vulnerabilities" "update_now" {
  status = ["update_now", "update_available"]
}

output "resource_names" {
  value = [for resource in data.coolify_vulnerabilities.update_now.resources : resource.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter results by field values. Multiple filters are ANDed together. Multiple values within a filter are ORed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `status` (List of String) Statuses to request: update_now, update_available, no_fix, check_needed, ok, not_checked. Omit to return every status.

### Read-Only

- `resources` (Attributes List) Resources with a stored security status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The field name to filter by.
- `values` (Set of String) The values to match against. Multiple values are ORed.


<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `environment_uuid` (String) Environment UUID. Null when the resource has no environment.
- `images` (Attributes) How many scanned images need an update, and how many images the status counts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources--images))
- `name` (String) Resource name.
- `project_uuid` (String) Project UUID. Null when the resource has no project.
- `security` (Attributes) Stored security status for the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources--security))
- `server_uuid` (String) Server UUID whose scan settings apply. Null when Coolify cannot resolve a server.
- `type` (String) application, service, or database.
- `uuid` (String) Application, service, or database UUID.

<a id="nestedatt--resources--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources.images`

Read-Only:

- `total` (Number) Images the status counts.
- `update` (Number) Scanned images whose stored status is update_now or update_available.


<a id="nestedatt--resources--security"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources.security`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Primary action sentence. Null when Coolify has no action text.
- `actions` (Attributes List) Suggested fixes. Empty when Coolify has none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources--security--actions))
- `any_exploited` (Boolean) True when any relevant finding is known exploited.
- `check_reason` (String) Why Coolify wants another check. Null when the status is not check_needed.
- `checked_at` (String) When Coolify stored this status, in ISO-8601. Null when the resource has not been checked.
- `critical_count` (Number) Critical findings that still need attention.
- `eol` (Attributes) End-of-life distribution for the scanned image. Null when the image is not a known end-of-life distro. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources--security--eol))
- `exploited_count` (Number) Known-exploited findings that still need attention.
- `high_count` (Number) High findings that still need attention.
- `label` (String) Status text Coolify shows on the Security page.
- `medium_count` (Number) Medium findings that still need attention.
- `problem_count` (Number) Findings that still need attention.
- `status` (String) Stored status: update_now, update_available, no_fix, check_needed, ok, or not_checked.

<a id="nestedatt--resources--security--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources.security.actions`

Read-Only:

- `copy` (String) Text Coolify offers to copy. Null when there is nothing to copy.
- `image` (String) Image ref the action applies to. Null when the action is not for one image.
- `ref` (String) Short ref Coolify attaches to the action. Null when absent.
- `sentence` (String) Sentence Coolify shows for the action.
- `target` (String) Image or version the action points at. Null when the action has no target.
- `type` (String) Action type Coolify assigned.


<a id="nestedatt--resources--security--eol"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources.security.eol`

Read-Only:

- `fixed` (Boolean) True when a newer image fixes the end-of-life status.
- `name` (String) Distribution name.
- `version` (String) Distribution version.
